stories.title: Arizona utility regulator tells audience, 'Data centers are my day job'
stories.summary: Arizona Corporation Commissioner Rene Lopez told an audience that data center protestors are "paid" and "an agreement" already protects customers from cost shifts.

stories.title: 41 counts of voyeurism brought against former Tempe school employee by grand jury
stories.summary: The indictment states that 29-year-old Antony Cruz is accused of committing 41 counts of voyeurism between July 16 and Aug. 21, 2026.

stories.title: Man faces second-degree murder in deadly Guadalupe shooting
stories.summary: Julian Paderez, 37, turned himself in and faces a second-degree murder charge in a September shooting in Guadalupe that left one man dead, says MCSO.

stories.title: Gobble up the sunshine: Arizona's Thanksgiving Forecast
stories.summary: Arizona’s forecast is serving up delicious Thanksgiving weather.

stories.title: Arizona Court of Appeals sides with 12News, strikes down unconstitutional gag order in farm mogul murder case
stories.summary: Appellate judges unanimously overturned a court order barring a 12News reporter from reporting on statements made during a public hearing.

stories.title: Phoenix ZooLights is back!
stories.summary: The holiday tradition has two miles of trails lit up by more than five million sparkling lights, hundreds of glowing displays and a 200-foot-long light tunnel.

stories.title: President Trump will head to Phoenix for groundbreaking of new TSMC chip-making plant
stories.summary: Announcement comes days after Trump helped restore Jensen Huang to Nvidia, which is TSMC's largest customer.

stories.title: Passenger accused of trying to open aircraft door forces American Airlines flight to land in Phoenix
stories.summary: Police say the passenger tried to manipulate an aircraft door and was restrained by crew members and fellow passengers before the plane landed safely at Sky Harbor.

stories.title: Family of man killed after struggle with Mesa PD filed $2M claim against city
stories.summary: The medical examiner classified Eric Baker's manner of death as homicide.

stories.title: Homicide investigation underway after 3 dead bodies are found in southern Arizona
stories.summary: A baby was flown to a hospital in Phoenix for medical treatment, Yuma police said.

stories.title: A wrong-number Thanksgiving text led to a decade of friendship. Now, it could become a movie.
stories.summary: Ten years after a wrong-number text brought them together, the Arizona duo is looking back on a friendship that has lasted through life's biggest moments.

stories.title: Suspect indicted for explosion at SRP substation in Mesa
stories.summary: The suspect is accused of causing an explosion at a substation that supplies power to a data center.
